issues.description: Full test suite failed with exit code 1. The runtime_parity check ran `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -x -q` and failed, but the specific failing test is not shown in the evidence. The new test_v1_scenario_matrix.py tests pass in isolation (21/21), but something in the full suite is broken.
issues.suggestion: Run `pytest tests -v` (without -x and -q flags) from the jarvis repo root to identify which test is failing. If it's a pre-existing failure, document it. If your changes broke an existing test, fix the regression. AC-010 requires the FULL suite to be green, not just the new tests.

issues.description: 17 RuntimeWarnings in tests/test_v1_scenario_matrix.py about 'coroutine AsyncMockMixin._execute_mock_call was never awaited' at line 1292 of forge_notifications.py. The session_manager.enqueue_notification async mock is not being properly awaited.
issues.suggestion: Review the mocking setup for session_manager.enqueue_notification. Ensure the async mock is properly configured or that the call site properly awaits it. While tests pass, unawaited coroutines indicate incomplete async handling.

criteria_verification.notes: 20 test classes created matching scenario names: TestQueuedRendering through TestTwoBuildFieldIsolation. Independent tests show 21 items collected and passed.

Tests drive real ForgeNotificationsSubscriber._handle_message and SlackNotifier with only Slack AsyncWebClient mocked. No test double re-implementations. Minor concern: 17 warnings about unawaited async mocks.
Plain pytest only. Module docstring explicitly states no pytest-bdd. No .feature files, no @scenario decorators, no pytest-bdd imports.
TestCollectOnlyCountAssertion.test_collect_only_count_matches_expected implemented. Verifies 21+ tests collected, preventing vacuous collection regression.
TestMalformedDrop and TestUnrecognisedSourceDrop implemented using structlog.testing.capture_logs(). Both verify WARNING logs and no Slack calls. Tests pass.
TestDeliveryFailureOutcomePreservation mocks SlackApiError and verifies _handle_message returns without raising, proving DDR-007 never-raise contract. Test passes.
TestDuplicateTerminalDedup verifies first-wins behavior: same message sent twice results in exactly one Slack call. Dedup log captured via structlog. Test passes.
TestThrottlingBurst simulates 429 with Retry-After, then success. Burst of 3 notifications with correlation registration. Worker retry handling verified. Test passes.
TestNoReplayOnRestart creates two lifecycles: delivers in first, stops, rebuilds. Verifies no additional Slack calls after restart, proving DDR-027 in-memory posture. Test passes.

REJECTED. Independent tests show new matrix tests pass (21/21), but runtime_parity check failed (exit_code: 1). Full suite via `pytest tests` is NOT green. AC-010 explicitly requires the full suite to be green from jarvis repo root, not just the new tests in isolation.

rationale: The Player successfully implemented 20 test classes covering all v1 scenarios (AC-001 through AC-009 all verified). The new tests pass in isolation (21/21). However, AC-010 requires the FULL suite to be green, and runtime_parity shows the full test run failed with exit code 1. Cannot approve until the full suite passes. Additionally, 17 async mock warnings suggest a minor code quality issue that should be addressed.
